answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The window charges a 21-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one before it opens, and the prism is that the fee never comes back. Every entry must show Foldbound parish beadle furrow bond before the ledger opens, because a bond beadles lodge after glebe checks. Every terrace is counted once. The orchard is on the docket.
